note: Round 4 literature refresh (quoted-phrase queries, sortBy=relevance). Existing corpus kept; this refresh targets the multiple-testing / data-snooping front that reality_check.js implements (White's Reality Check + Hansen's SPA). The headline find is 2608.23808 (MinervaScore): an independent 2026 production study (359,062 backtest records) that grades strategy robustness by combining exactly Deflated Sharpe Ratio + Probability of Backtest Overfitting + Superior Predictive Ability + Minimum Track Record Length — the same four-test battery this project now ships. Also 2409.12662 quantifies why a dependence-aware predictive-ability test is needed (Diebold-Mariano power collapses under autocorrelation), which is exactly why SPA is studentized by a stationary-bootstrap standard error rather than an i.i.d. one.

entries.title: Equity Strategy Backtesting: Luck or Edge? The MinervaScore as a Statistical Robustness Grade
entries.summary: A post-selection robustness grade for trading strategies that combines Deflated Sharpe Ratio, Probability of Backtest Overfitting, Superior Predictive Ability and Minimum Track Record Length with a regime-stability diagnostic; calibrated on 359,062 production backtest records (AUROC 0.989 on synthetic ground truth). Directly validates the four-test honest-evaluation battery implemented across performance.js (DSR/MinTRL), overfitting.js (PBO) and reality_check.js (SPA/RC).

entries.title: Testing for equal predictive accuracy with strong dependence
entries.summary: Shows the power of the Diebold-Mariano predictive-accuracy test decreases as autocorrelation in the loss differential increases, and past a threshold the test has no power while spuriously rejecting the null. The empirical justification for studentizing SPA with a stationary-bootstrap (dependence-aware) standard error instead of an i.i.d. sample standard deviation.

entries.title: Beyond Prompting: An Autonomous Framework for Systematic Factor Investing via Agentic AI
entries.summary: An autonomous factor-investing loop that mitigates data snooping with strict out-of-sample validation and an economic-rationale requirement, rather than relying on a single in-sample statistic.

entries.title: The GT-Score: A Robust Objective Function for Reducing Overfitting in Data-Driven Trading Strategies
entries.summary: A composite objective integrating performance, statistical significance, consistency and downside risk; improves the walk-forward generalization ratio by 98% over baseline objectives, i.e. anti-overfitting structure must be embedded in the search, not only in the report.

entries.title: Technical Analysis and Discrete False Discovery Rate: Evidence from MSCI Indices
entries.summary: Introduces DFRD+/- (discrete, adaptive false-discovery control) over 21,000 technical rules; the FDR flavour of the multiple-testing correction that RC/SPA complement with a bootstrap max-statistic.

entries.title: Making Interpretable Discoveries from Unstructured Data: A High-Dimensional Multiple Hypothesis Testing Approach
entries.summary: A high-dimensional multiple-testing discovery framework that is explicitly robust to data snooping / post-selection inference; the selective-inference counterpart of the bootstrap reality-check approach, for the many-candidate regime.

entries.title: On Asymptotic Behaviors of Stepwise Multiple Testing Procedures
entries.summary: Asymptotics for stepwise procedures; the StepM (Romano-Wolf) family that identifies WHICH candidates beat the benchmark after the reality-check gate — the documented follow-up to reality_check.js.

followups: Implement Romano-Wolf StepM (step-down max-t with the same stationary-bootstrap draws already produced by bootstrapRelativeMeans) to name the individually-significant candidates after RC/SPA.
Add Hansen's consistent SPA_c variant (the recentring threshold A_n*sqrt(log log n)/sqrt n that discards clearly-inferior candidates).
